source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Identify the non-conformities that should be noted.
3. Reach for the rubber-stamp that says "Conforms to ISO 27801".
4. Carefully blot out every section of the inspection record, then stamp the rubber-stamp in four places on the form.
5. Put the completed form into a folder marked "Passed audit".
6. Repeat annually.

## Additional Resources

* [ISO 27801:2019 - Environmental management - A short-course for dummies](https://iso.org/standard/81114.html)
